# Agentic First

Canonical site:

- https://agentic-first.co/

Alternate domain:

- https://agent-first.co/ redirects to https://agentic-first.co/

## What This Repo Owns

This repo owns the top-level Agentic First orientation site and route map.
It introduces Agentic First as a way to make organisations legible to
agents, then routes users into the Directory product and Tony Wood's
writing on agentic systems, governance, and operations.

## Product Areas

- Directory product: https://agentic-first.co/directory/
- Directory MCP: https://agentic-first.co/directory/mcp
- Directory source: https://github.com/yqup/pitch-mcp
